title: Meeting Preparation
prompt: Prepare a concise briefing for the selected project meeting using the event details and matching recent emails. Surface decisions, open questions, and the latest confirmed context.
instructions: Read only the selected event and the requested project email sample. Use get_event for the exact event and get_message for every message returned by list_messages. Keep the review to this meeting and its stated search window. Cite agenda and email records separately, flag conflicts rather than resolving them, and do not send messages, invite attendees, or alter the event.
